reason: I'm not at the salon half the time and I never know if the drawer cash matches what was actually done, so seeing takings, cancelled bills and who's in which chair from my phone is exactly what I lie awake about. With the first month free, I'd pay the setup and try it.
objection: My girls are busy with customers and if they just don't enter a walk-in or quietly skip the bill, the app shows me clean numbers that are still wrong, and I've wasted ₹4,999.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free month half the walk-ins still aren't being billed in the app, I'd cancel; and if the setup fee had to be paid before I see it working, I'd hesitate.
